findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "rpc" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_store_checks, get_campaign_funnels, get_why_no_buy, get_ad_copy_review · Private data: mark_fix_done · Public sink: get_campaigns, get_campaign_funnels, send_paused_draft · Destructive: get_performance, get_campaign_funnels, get_why_no_buy, get_ad_copy_review, get_audiences.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_store_checks, get_campaign_funnels, get_why_no_buy, get_ad_copy_review · Private data: mark_fix_done · Public sink: get_campaigns, get_campaign_funnels, send_paused_draft · Destructive: get_performance, get_campaign_funnels, get_why_no_buy, get_ad_copy_review, get_audiences

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
